evidence: Authorize a test-owned three-state branched cleanup compiler/linker control using local project compiler interaction. No proprietary bytes, fixed game layouts, compiler inference in the library, claim changes or acceptance permissions. Require a real relocatable PE, unchanged COFF replica, exact predecessor tuple, complete comparison, code-identical valid metadata-only mismatch and invalid-edge refusal. Existing experimental control passed only after using a normal CRT entry and real HIGHLOW-producing relocatable link; retain those earlier failures as diagnostics, not passes.
